Red Carpet

A bold red lip against a clean, sculpted base.

About this look

The timeless red-carpet formula: a flawless sculpted base, a defined eye kept quiet, and a precise red lip as the single focal point.

The direction

  • A flawless sculpted base
  • A softly defined eye
  • A precise, high-impact red lip

How to recreate it

  1. Build a smooth, even base and set the T-zone.
  2. Define the lash line with a coat of volumising mascara.
  3. Trace the lip with a liner for crisp edges.
  4. Fill with a bold red and blot for a lasting finish.
